body:
**What version of ESLint are you using?**
Master

**What parser (default, Babel-ESLint, etc.) are you using?**
default

**Please show your full configuration:**
testing with current head of node.js master on OSX 10.10.5

**What did you do? Please include the actual source code causing the issue.**

```
$ npm install
$ npm test
```

**What did you expect to happen?**
The test suite to pass

**What actually happened? Please include the actual, raw output from ESLint.**

```
 9920 passing (44s)
  6 failing

  1) CLIEngine executeOnText() should report one message when using local cwd .eslintrc:
     TypeError: Path must be a string. Received undefined
      at assertPath (path.js:7:11)
      at Object.extname (path.js:1469:5)
      at processText (lib/cli-engine.js:9:2174)
      at CLIEngine.executeOnText (lib/cli-engine.js:9:19381)
      at Context.<anonymous> (tests/lib/cli-engine.js:91:33)

  2) CLIEngine executeOnText() should report one message when using specific config file:
     TypeError: Path must be a string. Received undefined
      at assertPath (path.js:7:11)
      at Object.extname (path.js:1469:5)
      at processText (lib/cli-engine.js:9:2174)
      at CLIEngine.executeOnText (lib/cli-engine.js:9:19381)
      at Context.<anonymous> (tests/lib/cli-engine.js:110:33)

  3) CLIEngine getErrorResults() should report 4 error message when looking for errors only:
     TypeError: Path must be a string. Received undefined
      at assertPath (path.js:7:11)
      at Object.extname (path.js:1469:5)
      at processText (lib/cli-engine.js:9:2174)
      at CLIEngine.executeOnText (lib/cli-engine.js:9:19381)
      at Context.<anonymous> (tests/lib/cli-engine.js:1871:33)

  4) CLIEngine when evaluating code with comments to change config when allowInlineConfig is disabled should report a violation for disabling rules:
     TypeError: Path must be a string. Received undefined
      at assertPath (path.js:7:11)
      at Object.extname (path.js:1469:5)
      at processText (lib/cli-engine.js:9:2174)
      at CLIEngine.executeOnText (lib/cli-engine.js:9:19381)
      at Context.<anonymous> (tests/lib/cli-engine.js:2013:36)

  5) CLIEngine when evaluating code with comments to change config when allowInlineConfig is disabled should not report a violation by default:
     TypeError: Path must be a string. Received undefined
      at assertPath (path.js:7:11)
      at Object.extname (path.js:1469:5)
      at processText (lib/cli-engine.js:9:2174)
      at CLIEngine.executeOnText (lib/cli-engine.js:9:19381)
      at Context.<anonymous> (tests/lib/cli-engine.js:2039:36)

  6) cli execute() should return error when text with incorrect quotes is passed as argument:
     TypeError: Path must be a string. Received undefined
      at assertPath (path.js:7:11)
      at Object.extname (path.js:1469:5)
      at processText (lib/cli-engine.js:9:2174)
      at CLIEngine.executeOnText (lib/cli-engine.js:9:19381)
      at Object.cli.execute (lib/cli.js:9:5669)
      at Context.<anonymous> (tests/lib/cli.js:115:30)
```
